assessment.nobel_worthiness: Virus-like-particle HPV vaccines established a highly effective route to preventing infection and several major cancers, with exceptional public-health consequence.
assessment.attribution: The three named scientists form a coherent, prize-compatible account of the core virological insight and vaccine platform.
assessment.maturity: The preventive effect and broad clinical impact have been demonstrated over many years.
uncertainties: The relative division of credit among foundational papillomavirus research, VLP development, and later clinical implementation requires careful delimitation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: GLP-1 physiology enabled a therapeutic class that has transformed treatment of diabetes and obesity.
assessment.attribution: Holst, Mojsov, and Drucker represent a plausible three-person account spanning identification of the hormone, its physiological significance, and translational development.
assessment.maturity: The biological mechanism, therapeutic efficacy, and large-scale clinical impact are well established.
uncertainties: Credit for peptide discovery, receptor biology, and drug development is distributed across a wider community.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: CAR-T therapy made genetically engineered immune cells a durable and clinically powerful modality for otherwise difficult cancers.
assessment.attribution: The listed scientists provide a coherent account of the conceptual, engineering, and clinical development of the field.
assessment.maturity: Multiple approved products and sustained remissions establish maturity, while continuing refinement demonstrates a living platform.
uncertainties: The field rests on numerous foundational contributions to T-cell biology, gene transfer, and receptor design.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Chaperonin-assisted folding fundamentally changed understanding of how cells attain functional protein structure.
assessment.attribution: Horwich and Hartl are strongly and compactly associated with the decisive experimental and mechanistic advances.
assessment.maturity: The mechanism has been repeatedly confirmed and is foundational across cell biology and disease research.
uncertainties: The appropriate boundary between chaperonin-specific work and the broader protein-folding field requires careful framing.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Identification of CFTR provided a landmark demonstration of human disease-gene discovery and opened a molecular route to cystic-fibrosis treatment.
assessment.attribution: The three named researchers are a recognizable and prize-compatible group for the cloning and identification of CFTR.
assessment.maturity: The gene's causal role and its physiological and therapeutic implications are firmly established.
uncertainties: The prize narrative must distinguish gene identification from the later development of CFTR modulators.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Modern multichannel cochlear implants restored useful hearing and speech perception to large numbers of people, linking neurophysiology with a transformative medical technology.
assessment.attribution: Clark, Hochmair, and Wilson offer a focused account of key device and speech-processing advances.
assessment.maturity: The technology has undergone decades of clinical validation and worldwide use.
uncertainties: Important technical and clinical contributions extend beyond any three-person allocation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The recognition of distinct B- and T-lymphocyte lineages established a central organizing principle of adaptive immunity.
assessment.attribution: Miller and Cooper are tightly linked to the complementary discoveries defining T- and B-cell lineages.
assessment.maturity: The finding is foundational, extensively confirmed, and continues to underpin immunology and medicine.
uncertainties: The historical development of cellular immunology includes several adjacent contributions that require precise attribution.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Adult stem-cell-derived organoids created a broadly useful experimental system for studying tissue renewal, disease, and individualized medicine.
assessment.attribution: Clevers and Sato constitute a focused pairing for the demonstration and development of adult stem-cell organoid culture.
assessment.maturity: The approach has been reproduced widely and has reshaped experimental tissue biology.
uncertainties: Long-term clinical impact and the relation to other organoid and stem-cell systems remain less settled than the core experimental advance.
